messages:
ashley: Heads-up — noticed 30–80ms tail latency increase on streaming toolcall paths after today's merge (commit 4f9b2a5). Repro on staging. Anyone else seeing this?

priya: Yep, CI perf job flagged it. streaming-e2e p95 jumped ~60ms vs baseline at 10:12 UTC. Queueing a run now.

matt: I ran a quick profile on staging. Serialization/marshalling time for toolcall frames is up, and KV cache miss rate increased slightly (2% -> 6%). Full flame coming.

ashley: Repro steps:
```
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" "https://staging-api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=x"
# send a tool call from the client, observe chunk delays
```

matt: Short profiling snapshot:
```
before (baseline): marshal_toolcall: 12ms | kv_get: 1.1ms | sse_flush: 4.5ms
after (4f9b2a5):  marshal_toolcall: 46ms | kv_get: 3.8ms | sse_flush: 9.6ms
```

dave: Bisect points to commit 4f9b2a5 — it changed the SSE coalescer to batch toolcall frames to reduce network calls. Looks like the coalescer now waits too long for 'completion' markers before flushing toolcall frames.

priya: CI output: https://ci.redwood.ai/jenkins/job/streaming-e2e/781/console — perf test failing threshold. tagging as release-blocker.

ci-bot: [perf-job] streaming-e2e p95=198ms (threshold 160ms) — regression detected (compare: baseline p95=135ms)

ashley: I tried a quick revert of the coalescer change on staging — numbers returned to baseline. Recommend opening a revert PR and holding the rollout.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout paused for commit 4f9b2a5 (manual hold set by oncall-sre).

oncall-sre: Holding canary; this is a rollout blocker. Need revert PR + perf run before unblocking. :no_entry:

matt: Root cause hypothesis: we added an extra serialization pass to decorate toolcall frames for coalescing which blocks flush until downstream code finishes parsing. Two options: reduce coalesce wait window or inline the decoration so it doesn't add a second serialization.

dave: I'll draft minimal revert PR (#8330) to restore previous flushing semantics. Will run perf suite after merge.

ashley: PR #8330 created and linked to the incident. Running streaming-e2e now, will report.

priya: New run shows p95 back to 138ms. Looks good. Recommend backport to release branch.

matt: Followups: add unit test for coalescer timeout edge-case, add perf regression test to CI that asserts p95 not increase >10%.

ashley: Thanks all. Filing a short postmortem after rollback is merged. :+1:
